text: The per-stat CAP formulas diverge between builds in four of six rows, and one of them feeds the reach model directly. Positionally aligned, same six handlers in the same order: MAXHP web '10 + (lvl+10)*10' vs android '10 + (lvl+10)*5'; MAXCHI identical in both; MAXAP web '30 + (lvl+10)*5' vs android '20 + (lvl+10)'; ATK/DEF/SPD web '1 + (lvl+10)*3' vs android 'lvl + 10'. At level 8 the SPD cap is 55 on web and 18 on android — a 3x difference in the input to baseSlashLength = 120 + floor((90+5*DAN)*SPD/(20+SPD)). This makes the web level-8 Dan-0 reach ceiling 120 + floor(90*55/75) = 186, not the ~130 an android-capped reading gives.

text: The reload/focus meter constants also split by build, and the footage selects the web set — the cleanest cross-build parity datum in the repo. Web: maxreload = 8*24 = 192, HUD fraction (reload-48)/(192-48) = 144 ticks of visible travel = 6.000 s at 24.0 fps. Android: maxreload = 5*24 = 120, HUD fraction (reload-24)/(120-24) = 96 ticks = 4.000 s. The frame-measured fill is 45.0 px/s across a 268 px track = 5.96-6.00 s, which matches the WEB constants and rules out the android ones by 2 seconds.
